text: 当地时间2026年11月8日，国家金融监督管理总局党委书记、局长丁向群与加拿大财政部长商鹏飞成功主持召开中加金融监管合作会议。来自中国人民银行、金融监管总局、中国证监会，以及加拿大财政部、中央银行、金融机构监管署的代表参加了会议。双方就金融市场最新发展情况、金融业双向开放等议题进行深入交流，取得积极成果。会议期间，金融监管总局与加拿大金融机构监管署共同签署了《关于中加金融监管对话的合作协议》。会议还对此前双方重启中加金融监管对话机制并召开新一轮对话表示欢迎。（国家金融监督管理总局网站）
text_en: On November 8, 2026, Ding Xiangqun, Party Secretary and Director of the National Financial Regulatory Administration (NFRA), and François-Philippe Champagne, Canada's Minister of Finance, successfully co-chaired the China-Canada Financial Regulatory Cooperation Meeting. Representatives from the People's Bank of China (PBOC), the NFRA, the China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC), as well as Canada's Department of Finance, Bank of Canada, and Office of the Superintendent of Financial Institutions attended the meeting. The two sides held in-depth exchanges on topics including the latest developments in financial markets and two-way opening of the financial sector, achieving positive results. During the meeting, the NFRA and Canada's Office of the Superintendent of Financial Institutions jointly signed the Cooperation Agreement on the China-Canada Financial Regulatory Dialogue. The meeting also welcomed the earlier relaunch of the China-Canada financial regulatory dialogue mechanism by both sides and the convening of a new round of dialogue. (NFRA website)
